description: Shared validator cases. Read by tests/validator.test.ts (TypeScript) and agent/tests/test_validator.py (Python). expectedCodes lists issue codes in order; messageIncludes are substrings of the joined issue messages; expectedStatus, when present, is the Rule D hypothesis status; missingData, when present, is passed as the proposal's missing-data list. Rule B ignores generic phrases that are themselves rejected or negated (B-context cases); B-smuggle cases must still fail. Rule E (ROOT_CAUSE_UNCITED) and Rule D's ROOT_CAUSE_STATED_AS_FACT cases include the SAP AI Core outputs recorded in VERIFICATION.md, which must keep passing. Rule F cases (prefix F:) cover SAP sandbox sample data used as evidence. Rule G cases (prefix G:) cover an uploaded photo or document used as evidence. ID-draft cases cover the Indonesian wording of agent drafts (Draft language: Bahasa Indonesia).

cases.name: SAP: gpt-5.4 case a, NCR-2026-100, first run 2026-10-21, passes
cases.text: Unverified hypothesis: coating thickness may be below specification due to a worn spray gun nozzle causing low and uneven coating output. This matches the confirmed causes in NCR-2024-063, NCR-2023-030, and NCR-2024-049, where spray pattern testing confirmed reduced and uneven output from worn nozzles. Cited: NCR-2024-063, NCR-2023-030, NCR-2024-049.
missingData: No current-lot evidence is registered for NCR-2026-100.
Spray pattern test result for the spray gun/nozzle used on the affected lot is needed to verify whether output is low or uneven.
Nozzle condition and replacement history for the equipment used on the affected lot is needed.
Current-lot dry film thickness measurement map by part/location is needed to compare the defect pattern with the historical nozzle-wear cases.
Verification of DFT gauge status/calibration used for the current inspection is needed.

Cited: NCR-2025-084, NCR-2023-002, NCR-2023-007.
